title: SDD Orchestrator Root Manifest
description: Top-down routing contract at <monorepo-root>/.sdd/manifest.json when monorepo packages are onboarded with root-level templates and package-level specs. It routes to each onboarded package's own .sdd/manifest.json, which remains governed by sdd-manifest.schema.json. It carries no modules, commands, contracts, coverage, or validation state of its own. Seeded at .sdd/templates/repo-annotation/.manifest.schema.json, where it takes precedence over the per-package manifest schema for the root manifest only. Path, link, and filesystem rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by scripts/check_orchestrator_root.py.

manifest_version.description: Version of this orchestrator root manifest contract.

manifest_kind.description: Distinguishes the routing-only root manifest from a package or single-repo manifest.

topology.description: The containing repository's topology. Every routed package manifest records the same value.

purpose.description: One sentence: what this monorepo is.

workspace_declarations.description: Committed workspace/build declarations that define the monorepo's package roots, read from real config (never guessed).

source_file.description: Repository-relative workspace/build file, for example package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, settings.gradle, go.work, or Cargo.toml.

patterns.description: Package-root patterns exactly as the source file declares them.

agent_entry_path.description: Root agent entry carrying the managed package-routing block.

index_path.description: Root documentation home carrying the managed package-routing block.

canonical.description: Resolved Repo Standards snapshot shared with every routed package through its .sdd/templates symlink.

overrides.description: Plugin-owned root overrides. A file listed in its override-map.json takes precedence over the matching repo-standards template for root-level generation only.

root_artifact_decisions.description: Exactly one decision for each root artifact. create: the file was absent and was generated in full. update-routing: the file existed and only its managed routing content was inserted or refreshed. reuse: the file existed and was left byte-for-byte unchanged. The repo-context schema is never update-routing.

packages.description: One entry per onboarded package, added when that package's own .sdd/manifest.json is written. Packages that have not been onboarded are not listed.

id.description: Stable package identifier, unique within the root manifest.

path.description: Repository-relative package root, which is the package's SDD root.

templates_link.description: <path>/.sdd/templates — a relative symlink to the root .sdd/templates.

onboarded_by.description: Opaque generator runtime id that wrote the package manifest.

source.description: WebexTools/repo-standards@<commit> recorded by the seeded template map.

overrides_source.description: repo-annotation-overrides@<overrides_version> recorded by the seeded override map.

generated_by.description: Opaque generator runtime id of the most recent root update.
